# Packing Guideline

This text is a placeholder. The store replaces it with its final packing rules before any real vendor is invited.

## 1. Pack Only the Assigned Items

Put in the parcel only the items assigned to you for that order. Do not add extra goods, samples or offers.

## 2. Use Approved Paper Only

Use only the paper, labels and inserts that the store supplies or approves. Do not add any other printed material.

## 3. Show No Vendor Identity

Do not show your logo, name, phone number or web address on the box or inside it. Remove old labels and reused-box markings.

## 4. Keep the Assignment Reference Visible

Keep the assignment reference that the store gives you visible on the parcel, so the store can match the parcel to the order.

## 5. Report Damaged Goods

If an item is damaged or missing, do not send it. Mark it in the portal and wait for the store's answer.
